shadows.name: modal-blur
shadows.purpose: Separate modal and sheet layers from live content.

motion.name: enter
motion.purpose: Bring a new sheet or content surface into place.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Give buttons a tactile response without delaying activation.

motion.name: glass-notice
motion.purpose: Reveal status messages from a small point above navigation.

motion.name: sheet-settle
motion.purpose: Return a partially dragged sheet to rest.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Accent-filled 48dp action with a 16dp radius and optional leading icon.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Translucent tonal action with ink label and accent icon.

components.name: Script Card
components.description: Dense 22dp surface for title, author, description, metadata, and quick actions.

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Four fixed destinations with tonal selection and icon plus label.

components.name: Draggable Sheet
components.description: A 30dp glass layer with drag handle, scrollable body, and optional pinned action.

components.name: Themed Modal
components.description: A centered glass decision or error surface with explicit recovery actions.

components.name: Glass Notice
components.description: A bottom status pill that expands from a point and respects reduced motion.

components.name: Interface Variant
components.description: Switches between Liquid Glass and system styling, with comfortable or compact density.

narrative.overview: Familiar Android structure gains quiet depth through cool grounds, translucent tonal surfaces, and restrained violet accents. Glass is functional: it marks a floating layer while content remains dense and readable.
keyCharacteristics: Cool authored light and dark themes

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Accent identifies action or selection and does not tint ordinary cards.

rules.name: The Earned Glass Rule
rules.body: Blur belongs only to floating layers with a clear foreground and background.

rules.name: The Code Exception Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for Lua, UUIDs, and exact data.

dos: Show cached content immediately while refreshing
Keep battle launch above long parameter lists
Use shared icons and 48dp touch targets
donts: Hide recovery actions in generic errors
